// ============================================================
// RSQ Wheel -- MENUDEF
// ============================================================
//
// REMA's weapon wheel, under the series' one Options entry (design/MENU_STANDARD.md, owner 11-24): the
// front page holds the choices a player makes, short labels, On/Off; Test and Debug holds the rarer
// switches and the raw numbers (each row's "// tip:" comment says what it does); then Reset All (the series' RSQWHResetAll row; KEYCONF's wr_reset stays
// for configs, generated by tools/gen_reset.py).
//
// NOT IN THE MENU, ON PURPOSE (their cvars stay, so a config or REMA can still set them): what
// does nothing on stock QuestZDoom 17.3 (wr_q_shim.zs answers it with a no-op). The engine's
// native wheel (wr_suppress_native_wheel), the room effects (wr_vbeam*, wr_sweep*, wr_fog*,
// wr_floor*, wr_wave*), painted card faces (wr_canvas*, wr_scan_crawl), the SDF plate and its
// glow (wr_sdf, wr_glow, wr_plate_radius, wr_plate_border), and the weapon-mod readers that
// only read another mod's fields by name (Doomablo, DOOM Infinite, Pandemonia, Guncaster,
// BorderDoom: wr_dbl/di/pand/gc/bd_compat). The gun cards are their own mod, RSQ Gun Cards.

// ---- Radiant Silvergun Options (tools/rsmenu) ----------------------------------------------------
// The series' one Options entry. Every series pk3 carries this same block with its own prefix: the
// parent is PROTECTED, so the first definition stays and later ones add nothing (QZD 17.3 merges a
// protected option menu instead of replacing it); the link row removes any earlier copy of itself,
// so Options shows one row however many series pk3s load. Each mod then adds its own row only.
OptionMenu "RSQ_RSOptions" protected
{
	Class "RSQWH_RSMenu"
	Title "RADIANT SILVERGUN OPTIONS"
}

AddOptionMenu "OptionsMenu"
{
	RSQWHRSLink "Radiant Silvergun Options", "RSQ_RSOptions"
}

AddOptionMenu "RSQ_RSOptions"
{
	Submenu "RSQ Wheel", "wr_Options"
}
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OptionString "wr_Palettes"
{
	"Standard", "Standard"
	"Doom",     "Doom"
	"Hell",     "Hell"
	"Tech",     "Tech"
}

OptionString "wr_FontSets"
{
	"Score",     "RSQ Score's font"
	"Combo",     "RSQ Score's combo font"
	"JFO",       "JFO"
	"StatusBar", "Status bar numerals"
	"SmallGold", "Small gold numerals"
	"SmallGrey", "Small grey numerals"
	"DoomFont",  "DoomFont only"
	"Ermac",     "Ermac's digits"
}

OptionValue "wr_RingArt"
{
	0, "Ermac Style"
	1, "Stone"
}

OptionValue "wr_WheelMode"
{
	1, "On"
	0, "Off"
}

// Which hand the Open Wheel key opens the ring in front of (with Either Hand on, both hands still pick).
OptionValue wr_ToggleHandPref
{
	0,  "Main Hand"
	1,  "Off Hand"
}

// What a crowded slot unfolds into: the fan (three lanes stacked outward) or stars round the card.
OptionValue wr_FanStyle
{
	0, "Fan"
	1, "Constellation"
}

// Slot colour first: the burst comes out the card's own hue, so it confirms which one you hit.
OptionValue wr_SparkColors
{
	0, "Slot Colour"
	1, "White Hot"
	2, "Rainbow"
}

// LED first: it survives a dark room, which is where this mostly gets used.
OptionValue wr_Readouts
{
	0, "LED"
	2, "Badge"
}

OptionValue wr_WebView
{
	0, "Marine"
	1, "Mirror"
}

// How the weapons go round the ring (wr_ring_layout; owner 2026-11-17). Always Group is the default, as shipped.
// What time does while the ring is up (wr_time; owner 2026-11-27). Frozen is the default, as shipped.
OptionValue wr_TimeOpen
{
	0, "Normal"
	1, "Slow"
	2, "Frozen"
}

OptionValue wr_RingLayout
{
	0, "Every Gun"
	1, "When Crowded"
	2, "Always Group"
}

OptionValue wr_CardLook
{
	1, "By Gun"
	0, "Classic"
}

OptionMenu wr_Options
{
	Title "RSQ WHEEL"
	// wr_wheel_mode is mirrored onto wr_suppress_native_wheel (REMA) as (mode != 2), so Off never
	// hands back an engine wheel.
	// tip: Turns the weapon wheel on or off.
	Option "Weapon Wheel",              "wr_wheel_mode",   "wr_WheelMode"
	// tip: The key that opens and closes the wheel. Choose a card with the trigger.
	Control "Open Wheel",               "+wr_wheel"    // owner 11-10: one key; the toggles went. 11-27: it opens and closes, the trigger chooses
	// tip: Either hand can point at a card and the gun goes into that hand; off, only the hand that opened it picks.
	Option "Either Hand",               "wr_either_hand",  "OnOff"
	// tip: Every gun its own card, a card per slot only when crowded, or always a card per slot that opens to its guns.
	Option "Ring Layout",               "wr_ring_layout",  "wr_RingLayout"
	// tip: Next and previous weapon skip guns that have a holster; the guns they do reach get a gold light on their card.
	Option "Skip Holstered Guns",       "wr_cycle_skip_holstered", "OnOff"
	// tip: Size of the whole wheel: distance, cards and reach together.
	Slider "Wheel Size",                "wr_scale",        0.3, 3.0, 0.05, 2
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Time", 1
	// tip: What time does while the wheel is open: runs, slows, or stops. Slow uses RSQ SlowMo; without it, time stops.
	Option "Time While Open",           "wr_time",         "wr_TimeOpen"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Look", 1
	// tip: The wheel's colour scheme.
	Option "Palette",                   "wr_palette",      "wr_Palettes"
	// tip: By Gun colours each card in its gun's colour with lit stone and halos; Classic is the ring as it was.
	Option "Card Look",                 "wr_look2",        "wr_CardLook"
	// tip: Each card shows the gun's turning voxel model instead of its icon.
	Option "Gun Models",                "wr_models",       "OnOff"
	// tip: A data sheet with the hovered gun's stats opens beside the wheel.
	Option "Data Sheet",                "wr_sheet",        "OnOff"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Feel", 1
	// tip: Clicks on hover, expand, pick and close.
	Option "Sound",                     "wr_sound",        "OnOff"
	// tip: Strength of the controller rumble (QuestZDoom's own haptics switch still overrules it).
	Slider "Rumble",                    "wr_haptics",      0.0, 2.0, 0.1, 1
	StaticText " "
	// tip: Opens the rarer switches, every raw number and the debug log.
	Submenu "Test and Debug",           "wr_Test"
	// Reset All: every cvar a row names on both pages, plus (third argument) the ones with no row, as wr_reset does.
	// tip: Puts every RSQ Wheel setting on both pages back to its default.
	RSQWHResetAll "Reset All", "Reset all RSQ Wheel settings?", "wr_suppress_native_wheel wr_vbeam wr_vbeam_inner wr_vbeam_outer wr_vbeam_density wr_vbeam_dust wr_sweep wr_sweep_reach wr_sweep_bright wr_fog wr_fog_rise wr_fog_scatter wr_sdf wr_plate_radius wr_plate_border wr_floor wr_floor_kind wr_floor_count wr_floor_space wr_floor_spin wr_floor_thick wr_floor_bright wr_floor_seam wr_canvas wr_canvas_bleed wr_canvas_shadow wr_canvas_scan wr_glow wr_wave wr_wave_len wr_wave_speed wr_wave_sharp wr_scan_crawl wr_dbl_compat wr_pand_compat wr_gc_compat wr_bd_compat wr_di_compat"
}

OptionMenu wr_Test
{
	Title "RSQ WHEEL: TEST AND DEBUG"
	// Every one is live: the next tic has it.
	StaticText "Picking", 1
	// tip: Which hand the Open Wheel key opens the ring in front of.
	Option "Opens On",                  "wr_toggle_prefer_hand", "wr_ToggleHandPref"
	// tip: With When Crowded, up to this many weapons each get their own card; past it, one card per slot.
	Slider "Own Cards Up To",           "wr_subcards_max", 0, 99, 1, 0
	// tip: Where the ring would open into a wall it slides away, steps toward you, or shrinks to fit.
	Option "Keep Out of Walls",         "wr_walls",        "OnOff"
	// tip: A different gun's card under your other hand turns the sheet into a side by side comparison.
	Option "Two Hands Compare",         "wr_twohand_compare", "OnOff"
	// tip: The ring opens with your gun's card under your hand.
	Option "Open on Your Gun",          "wr_centre_held",  "OnOff"
	// tip: Bring a forearm up across your chest as if checking a watch, and that hand's gun shows its card.
	Option "Wrist Card",                "wr_watch",        "OnOff"
	// tip: The wheel opens at the start of every map (for testing).
	Option "Open at Level Start",       "wr_autoopen",     "OnOff"
	// tip: With Time While Open on Slow: closing the wheel also ends slow time that something else started.
	Option "Close Ends Slow Time",      "wr_slowmo_cancel", "OnOff"
	// tip: No moving or stick turning in the game while the wheel is up (walking and looking round in the room still work).
	Option "Hold Still While Open",     "wr_hold_still",   "OnOff"
	// (owner 2026-11-27: Off Hand Alt Picks removed with its row: the off hand's alt fire always picks, the wheel stays open)
	// (owner 2026-11-27: Pull a Card Out, Throw a Gun Back and Reach In are removed, with their rows)
	// tip: How much each card's rumble tick is shaped by the gun's weight.
	Slider "Gun Weight Feel",           "wr_weight_feel",  0.0, 1.0, 0.1, 1
	// tip: Ticks a pick must be held before it counts.
	Slider "Hold to Pick (tics)",       "wr_hold_tics",    3, 35, 1, 0
	// tip: A second tap within this many tics closes the wheel and puts your last gun back (0 is off).
	Slider "Double Tap (tics)",         "wr_doubletap",    0, 20, 1, 0
	// tip: Turn more than this far away from the ring and it swings round ahead of you again (0 is never).
	Slider "Ring Follows Past (deg)",   "wr_follow",       0, 120, 5, 0
	// tip: Tics the wheel stays up with nothing hovered before it folds away.
	Slider "Folds After (tics)",        "wr_locktics",     35, 700, 35, 0
	// Steps of 5 so the default (25 tics) sits on the scale.
	// tip: Tics of warning before the wheel folds away (0 is no warning).
	Slider "Fold Warning (tics)",       "wr_warn_tics",    0, 105, 5, 0
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Look", 1
	// tip: The ring's plates: its own Ermac style or the status bar's stone.
	Option "Ring Plates",               "wr_ring_art",     "wr_RingArt"
	// tip: The holster web shows the marine or the Tactical Rig's mirror of you.
	Option "Web View",                  "wr_web_view",     "wr_WebView"
	// tip: Shows each weapon's ammo under its name.
	Option "Ammo Counts",               "wr_ammo",         "OnOff"
	// tip: How the ammo count is drawn.
	Option "Ammo Readout",              "wr_readout",      "wr_Readouts"
	// tip: Cards are coloured by the weapon's rarity tier.
	Option "Rarity Colours",            "wr_tier_color",   "OnOff"
	// tip: Marks the cards of guns you are already holding.
	Option "Mark Guns You Hold",        "wr_marker",       "OnOff"
	// tip: Shows each card's slot number.
	Option "Slot Numbers",              "wr_slotnum",      "OnOff"
	// tip: Cards turn to face you, making the ring a shallow bowl.
	Option "Cards Face You",            "wr_facing",       "OnOff"
	// tip: A crowded slot unfolds as a fan or as stars round the card.
	Option "Crowded Slot Style",        "wr_constellation", "wr_FanStyle"
	// tip: The hovered card's halo breathes.
	Option "Hover Halo Breathes",       "wr_breathe",      "OnOff"
	// tip: A spark runs round each card's edge.
	Option "Edge Sweep",                "wr_edge_sweep",   "OnOff"
	// tip: The ring flashes when a fan opens or a pick is confirmed.
	Option "Flash on Pick",             "wr_flash",        "OnOff"
	// tip: Colour of the burst off the card you take.
	Option "Spark Colour",              "wr_spark_color",  "wr_SparkColors"
	// tip: The hovered card lights the room with one light.
	Option "Hover Light",               "wr_light",        "OnOff"
	// tip: How many quiet stars twinkle behind the ring.
	Slider "Background Stars",          "wr_stars",        0, 200, 10, 0
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Data Sheet", 1
	// tip: The data sheet shows the weapon's stats.
	Option "Weapon Stats",              "wr_sheet_stats",  "OnOff"
	// tip: Counts kills and accuracy per weapon as you play.
	Option "Track Kills and Accuracy",  "wr_stats_track",  "OnOff"
	// tip: Adds a row with this level's kills and accuracy.
	Option "Level Kills",               "wr_level_stats",  "OnOff"
	// tip: Shows each gun's Gun Bonsai level and upgrades on the sheet.
	Option "Gun Bonsai Rows",           "wr_sheet_bonsai", "OnOff"
	// tip: Point at a gun on the floor and the sheet shows it against what that hand holds.
	Option "Point at a Gun",            "wr_inspect",      "OnOff"
	// tip: Only a gun this close shows its card when you point at it.
	Slider "Inspect Within (m)",        "wr_inspect_reach", 0.5, 10, 0.1, 1
	// tip: The inspect card shows the difference from your own gun.
	Option "Compare With Yours",        "wr_inspect_delta", "OnOff"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Other Mods", 1
	// tip: Reads LegenDoom's weapon rarity onto the cards.
	Option "LegenDoom Rarity",          "wr_ld_compat",    "OnOff"
	// tip: Shows a LegenDoom weapon's effects row on the sheet.
	Option "LegenDoom Effects",         "wr_ld_effects",   "OnOff"
	// PARKED (owner 2026-11-09: "disable wheel mod support for now"): the other mods' rows are hidden and their readers
	// answer off (wr_modsupport.zs). Kept here, commented, for when support comes back:
	// Option "DoomRL Arsenal Tier",       "wr_drla_compat",  "OnOff"
	// Option "DoomRL Mod Upgrades",       "wr_drla_mods",    "OnOff"
	// Option "Combined Arms Meters",      "wr_ca_compat",    "OnOff"
	// Option "Final Doomer Set",          "wr_fd_compat",    "OnOff"
	// Option "MetaDoom Demon Keys",       "wr_meta_compat",  "OnOff"
	// Option "ModelSwapper",              "wr_ms_compat",    "OnOff"
	// Control "ModelSwapper: Main Hand",  "wr_ms_cycle_main"
	// Control "ModelSwapper: Off Hand",   "wr_ms_cycle_off"
	// Option "Lithium",                   "wr_lith_compat",  "OnOff"
	// Option "Lithium RPG Stats",         "wr_lith_acs",     "OnOff"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Ring", 1
	// tip: How far ahead of you the ring opens.
	Slider "Ring Distance Ahead",       "wr_forward",      5.0, 120.0, 1.0, 0
	// tip: Radius of the ring.
	Slider "Ring Radius",               "wr_radius",       1.0, 40.0, 0.5, 1
	// tip: How high above your hand the ring sits.
	Slider "Height Above Hand",         "wr_rise",        -8.0, 12.0, 0.5, 1
	// tip: Leans the tops of the cards toward you.
	Slider "Lean Toward You",           "wr_tilt",       -30.0, 30.0, 1.0, 0
	// tip: How much wrist roll spins the ring (0 ignores it).
	Slider "Wrist Roll Spin",           "wr_roll",         0.0, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Thumbstick deadzone for picking with the stick.
	Slider "Stick Deadzone",            "wr_stickdead",    0.05, 0.9, 0.05, 2
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Cards", 1
	// tip: Width of a card.
	Slider "Card Width",                "wr_panel_w",      1.0, 12.0, 0.25, 2
	// tip: Height of a card.
	Slider "Card Height",               "wr_panel_h",      1.0, 12.0, 0.25, 2
	// tip: How far the hovered card steps toward you.
	Slider "Hover Step Out",            "wr_pop",          0.0, 6.0, 0.25, 2
	// tip: How much bigger the hovered card grows.
	Slider "Hover Grow",                "wr_pulse",        0.0, 0.5, 0.01, 2
	// tip: How far the other cards fade once one is hovered.
	Slider "Others Fade To",            "wr_dim",          0.05, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Tics the cards take to grow out of your wrist.
	Slider "Cards Grow In (tics)",      "wr_growtics",     0, 20, 1, 0
	// tip: Strength of the shadow behind each card.
	Slider "Card Shadow",               "wr_shadow",       0.0, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: How far the card shadow is offset.
	Slider "Shadow Offset",             "wr_shadow_offset", 0.0, 1.5, 0.05, 2
	// tip: How much the ring rises and falls while it sits there.
	Slider "Idle Breathing",            "wr_idle",         0.0, 2.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Speed of the idle breathing.
	Slider "Breathing Speed",           "wr_idle_speed",   0.2, 6.0, 0.1, 1
	// tip: A weapon below this share of its ammo counts as low.
	Slider "Low Ammo Below (share)",    "wr_lowammo_frac", 0.0, 0.9, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Strength of the low ammo pulse.
	Slider "Low Ammo Pulse",            "wr_lowammo_pulse", 0.0, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: How fast the gun model turns on its card (0 holds it still).
	Slider "Model Turn Speed",          "wr_model_spin",   0.0, 6.0, 0.25, 2
	// tip: Size of the gun model on its card.
	Slider "Model Size",                "wr_model_scale",  0.02, 1.0, 0.02, 2
	// tip: How far the gun model stands off its card.
	Slider "Model Stand Off",           "wr_model_lift",   0.0, 12.0, 0.5, 1
	// tip: Tics a fan stays open after your hand strays off it.
	Slider "Fan Close Grace (tics)",    "wr_subcards_grace", 0, 20, 1, 0
	// tip: Tics between each line of a constellation drawing in.
	Slider "Star Line Stagger (tics)",  "wr_star_stagger", 0, 12, 1, 0
	// tip: Peak brightness of the background stars.
	Slider "Star Brightness",           "wr_stars_alpha",  0.0, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Size of the hover light.
	Slider "Light Size",                "wr_light_size",   8.0, 160.0, 4.0, 0
	// tip: Tics the hover light holds between cards.
	Slider "Light Grace (tics)",        "wr_light_grace",  0, 12, 1, 0
	// tip: Particles in the burst off a card you take (0 is off).
	Slider "Sparks",                    "wr_sparks",       0.0, 80.0, 2.0, 0
	// tip: Speed of the spark burst.
	Slider "Spark Speed",               "wr_sparks_speed", 0.2, 4.0, 0.1, 1
	// tip: Volume of the wheel's sounds.
	Slider "Volume",                    "wr_volume",       0.0, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Strength of the cards' idle shimmer.
	Slider "Idle Shimmer",              "wr_shimmer",      0.0, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Degrees the taken card spins as the ring folds away.
	Slider "Taken Card Spin (deg)",     "wr_flip",        -720.0, 720.0, 30.0, 0
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Data Sheet", 1
	// Measured in card widths.
	// tip: Size of the data sheet, in card widths.
	Slider "Data Sheet Size",           "wr_sheet_scale",  0.5, 4.0, 0.05, 2
	// tip: Tics you must point at a gun on the floor before its card shows.
	Slider "Inspect Rest (tics)",       "wr_inspect_dwell", 0, 70, 2, 0
	// tip: Tics the wrist card pose must be held.
	Slider "Wrist Card Hold (tics)",    "wr_watch_dwell",  2, 30, 1, 0
	// tip: Size of the wrist card.
	Slider "Wrist Card Size",           "wr_watch_scale",  0.5, 2.0, 0.1, 1
	// tip: A palette or font set added by another pk3, typed by its name.
	TextField "Palette by Name",        "wr_palette"
	StaticText " "
	// tip: Prints diagnostics to the console when the wheel opens.
	Option "Debug Log",                 "wr_debug",        "OnOff"
}
